sections.title: Unit 14: Visual Storytelling, Perspective & Time
body: Narrative pacing in Hungarian prose and film criticism depends on sophisticated temporal conjunctions that establish parallel actions (miközben, mialatt), immediate succession (amint, mihelyt, alighogy... máris), and recurrent cinematic rhythms (valahányszor, ahányszor csak).

Through Miklós Mészöly's stark existential masterpiece Magasiskola (1967)—adapted for cinema by István Gaál—you will explore how visual focus, spatial geometry, and the cold discipline of falconry on the Hungarian plain serve as a powerful allegory of power, obedience, and observation.
